# Specification

## Goal

Implement a user registration feature.

## Context

Users need to register using an email address and password.

## Functional Requirements

### FR-001

**Source:** USER

Users can provide an email address.

### FR-002

**Source:** USER

Users can provide a password.

## Non-Functional Requirements

### NFR-001

**Source:** ASSUMPTION

The registration process must protect user credentials.

## Acceptance Criteria

### AC-001

A user can register with valid credentials.

## Edge Cases

- Empty email.
- Empty password.
- Invalid email.

## Dependencies

- Authentication system.

## Open Questions

None.

## Assumptions

None.
